facts.text: I want to offer a free Scavenger Hunt event to entice people into joining my artist group called Creative Reinvention Studio.
I want to post tweets that announce the Scavenger Hunt for Artists to peak people's interest.
I want to write 5 tweets based on our discussion.
I want to promote a FREE 2023 Scavenger Hunt for artists and creatives.
I want to include a call to action to sign up to get more information.
I want tweet wording that asks whether people are feeling boxed in and unable to access their creative muscles.
I want suggestions for additional wording without using the word 'rut'.
I want to introduce the concept of 'reinvention' using words and synonyms like anticipate, design, implement, or manage expectations, strategic design, and action.
I want to shift the wording toward readiness, adaptation, dealing with change, and disruption.
I am not sure how many items should be in the scavenger hunt.
I do not want to overwhelm artists so they do not sign up.
I want a suggestion for a manageable number of scavenger hunt items.

keyphrases: manageable number of scavenger hunt items
